sentences: A lane mask register holds only this lane's bit, so WQM on one (EXEC, VCC, an SGPR the mask analysis found) ORs the bit of the lane's quad, lanes 4n..4n+3 of the wave: two `OpGroupNonUniformQuadSwap` (horizontal, then vertical; capability `GroupNonUniformQuad`) in the default mode in fragment and compute shaders (quad operations are only guaranteed there; vertex, geometry and mesh shaders shuffle from the quad's four lanes), or the four lanes' values read through `%x_buf` under `--wave64-emulate` (no subgroup operation there).

A quad never crosses lane 31/32, so the mask bits are exact per half on a 32-wide subgroup; SCC is a wave vote, so on wave64 it needs a 64-wide subgroup or `--wave64-emulate` (as every wave-wide mask op).
The result goes to EXEC, VCC or an SGPR pair as a mask, SCC = the wave-wide any of it (same vote as the other mask ops).
A 32-bit form in wave64 (`exec_lo`/`exec_hi`, `vcc_lo`/`vcc_hi`, a half-mask SGPR) writes only its own half (`exec_half_write`) and votes SCC over that half only (`cs_wqm_w64_half`).
A source that is not a lane mask (a value loaded from memory, a literal) is data: `((x | x>>1 | x>>2 | x>>3) & 0x11111111) * 15` per 32-bit word and SCC = result != 0, no subgroup operation.

Assumptions: in compute and mesh shaders the subgroup lane is `LocalInvocationIndex` mod the subgroup size (as for every cross-lane op); a hardware quad is four consecutive lanes of a wave, and in a pixel shader Vulkan's quad (the 2x2 pixels, helper invocations included) is the same four lanes; GPU-checked on both AMD and NVIDIA with `ps_wqm.asm` (every 2x2 block of a 64x64 target, fully covered).

Not covered: helper-invocation behaviour at triangle edges is untested, and in native mode an absent invocation in a partial quad (a compute group whose size is not a multiple of 4) gives an undefined value (emulated, the missing lanes of a partial wave read as 0).
Before this the instruction was the identity, so helper lanes stayed off (#156 SHADER-34: `s_wqm_b64` appears in 4,285 pixel shaders).

GPU-checked with `runtime/test/shaders/cs_wqm_w64.asm`, `cs_wqm_w64_half.asm`, `cs_wqm_w32.asm` and `ps_wqm.asm` on AMD Radeon 880M (subgroup 64) and NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Laptop (subgroup 32; `cs_wqm_w64` there needs `LEONIDA_W64_EMULATE=1`), with and without `--wave64-emulate`.
